# Expression-produced function values are callable; built-ins remain name-only.
fn inc(x){x+1}; (inc)(2) => 3
fn inc(x){x+1}; let alias=inc; (alias)(4) => 5
fn inc(x){x+1}; fn pick(){inc}; pick()(6) => 7
fn inc(x){x+1}; fn pick(){inc}; (pick())(8) => 9
fn inc(x){x+1}; (inc)(2,) + 4 => 7
fn first(xs,n){xs[n]}; (first)(push([3],4),len(push([7],8))-1) => 4
fn sum2(a,b){a[0]+b[0]}; (sum2)(push([1],2),push([3],4)) => 4
fn inc(x){x+1}; 0 && (inc)(1/0) => 0
fn inc(x){x+1}; 0 && (inc)(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9) => 0
fn inc(x){x+1}; 0 && (inc)(1 + *) => error:expected integer
fn inc(x){x+1}; (inc)(1/0) => error:division by zero
fn inc(x){x+1}; (inc)() => error:wrong argument count
fn inc(x){x+1}; (inc)(2 => error:expected closing parenthesis
let x=5; (x)() => error:expected function
let x=5; (x)(1/0) => error:division by zero
fn f(){1}; let saved=0; {fn old(){2}; saved=old; 0}; fn fresh(){3}; (saved)() => error:undefined identifier
fn inc(x){x+1}; let i=0; let n=0; while i<65 { n=n+(inc)(2); i=i+1; }; n => 195
